outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with western blot images; no quantification plot requiring averaged data points is present.

Bar charts showing % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance per antibody appear to be single densitometry measurements per antibody (no error bars, no mention of replicates/means), so this is not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual point overlay.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean ± SD (n=4) with individual replicate data points overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F shows a protein sequence alignment and a predicted crystal structure model; it is not a plot of averaged data and the check does not apply.
Panel G consists of scatter plots comparing enrichment ratios; scatter plots inherently show individual data points and are exempt.
Panel H is a scatter plot of individual IP-MS experiment values; scatter plots are exempt from requiring separate point overlay.
Panel I is a PCA scatter plot where each marker already represents an individual sample; scatter plots are exempt.
Panel J comprises PCA scatter plots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum) where each marker represents an individual sample; scatter plots are exempt.
